description: This file defines a helper class 'IntegrationTestSupport' for use in integration testing of the Eclipse Hono project. It contains methods for setting up test environment components such as device registry and message clients, sending commands to devices, managing test resources, and various utility functions for JSON containment checks, cryptographic operations, and certificate handling.

classes.name: IntegrationTestSupport
classes.description: A utility class providing support methods for integration tests within the Eclipse Hono project, including environment setup, resource cleanup, command messaging, cryptography, and JSON comparison utilities.
